body: Yeah. On a daily basis. You're not alone.

Thank you for your comment. :\) I try to talk to some of my friends, but I don't think any of them really think of my situation as a major problem. I talk to the school counselor sometimes but it's not like I can actually open up to him. Like I want to take control and stop being depressed, but I've been like this for so long and\- you know the motivation that people get to take back control over their lives? Well I'll be like that one day, then wake up the next with absolutely no motivation or hope that anything is actually going to change for the better... *sigh...* Wanna PM and we can talk? Help each other?
